title: Semantic Density Does Not Predict Agent-Memory Collapse
abstract: arXiv:2611.33184v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Persistent textual memory can improve LLM agents, but repeated updates can erode task performance. We ask whether memory-store statistics warn before held-out accuracy declines. We registered mean pairwise cosine similarity ($\rho$) and 13 additional geometry, retrieval, and graph statistics on 805 snapshots from 13 memory methods across ALFWorld, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, and two ARC-AGI settings. These methods store trajectories, rules, workflows, strategies, or linked records, using selective retrieval or whole-store prompting. No such statistic reliably predicted early signs of task accuracy decline, and $\rho$ had zero median lead. With the checkpoint after peak accuracy as a secondary decline point, measures of highly similar pairs and nearest-neighbor crowding changed earlier but did not consistently outperform stored-item count. We trained classifiers on this corpus and applied them unchanged to PropWorld runs of up to 5

translated_title: 语义密度无法预测智能体记忆崩溃
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.33184v1 公告类型：交叉（cross）。摘要：持久化的文本记忆可以提升大语言模型（LLM）智能体的能力，但反复的记忆更新可能会侵蚀任务性能。我们探究记忆库的统计指标能否在留出集准确率下降之前发出预警。我们在来自13种记忆方法、覆盖ALFWorld、AppWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop以及两个ARC-AGI设置共805个快照上，预先注册了平均成对余弦相似度（ρ）以及另外13种几何、检索和图统计指标。这些方法存储轨迹、规则、工作流、策略或链接记录，并采用选择性检索或全库提示的方式。结果显示，没有任何此类统计指标能可靠预测任务准确率下降的早期迹象，且ρ的中位领先时间为零。若以准确率峰值之后的检查点作为次级下降点，高相似对数量和最近邻拥挤度等指标虽然变化得更早，但并未一致地优于单纯的存储条目数量。我们在该语料库上训练了分类器，并将其不加修改地应用于PropWorld中多达5（此处摘要被截断）
tldr: 本文通过大规模预注册实验发现，包括平均成对余弦相似度在内的记忆库统计指标均无法可靠预测智能体任务准确率的早期下降，即语义密度不能作为智能体记忆崩溃的有效预警信号。
en_tdlr: Through a large-scale registered study across 13 memory methods and multiple agent benchmarks, this paper shows that memory-store statistics—including mean pairwise cosine similarity (semantic density)—fail to reliably predict early declines in agent task accuracy.
